critical_distinction.DA_vs_unrestricted_cash: Distribution Account (DA) is a covenant/DSCR gate mechanism. Unrestricted corporate cash is the dividend-accounting residual after gross dividends are paid. These are completely separate concepts in both workbooks.
critical_distinction.TUHO_DA_block: CF98-CF100 = TUHO Distribution Account block (covenant gate)
critical_distinction.TUHO_CF108: UNRESTRICTED_CASH_AVAILABLE — dividend cash cap at the later dividend-accounting stage (CF106+), NOT the DA block
critical_distinction.Oborovo_DA_block: CF108-CF110 = Oborovo Distribution Account block (covenant gate)
critical_distinction.Oborovo_CF108: DA_AVAILABLE — covenant gate input, NOT dividend cash cap
critical_distinction.Oborovo_CF118: UNRESTRICTED_CASH_AVAILABLE — dividend cash cap at the later dividend-accounting stage (CF116+)
critical_distinction.b21_vs_b118: P&L B21 is financing-income WHT (on cash/DSRA interest). CF!B118/CF!B128 are dividend WHT rates — separate concepts.
